mutations.name: drop-guard
mutations.why: the listing overwrites a tab pushed while the list was asked: the code before the fix
mutations.search: /\ view' = IF UseGuard /\ pushCount > req[r].sent THEN view ELSE req[r].snap

mutations.name: count-taken-at-answer
mutations.why: the push count is read when the answer lands instead of before the ask, so no push ever counts as since
mutations.search: /\ view' = IF UseGuard /\ pushCount > req[r].sent THEN view ELSE req[r].snap
mutations.replace: /\ view' = IF UseGuard /\ pushCount > pushCount THEN view ELSE req[r].snap

mutations.name: change-without-push
mutations.why: main changes the tab without a TAB_STATUS (the assumption the guard rests on): a skipped listing was the only news
mutations.search:
/\ pushes' = Append(pushes, mainV + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<view, pushCount, req, late>>
mutations.replace:
/\ pushes' = IF mainV = 1 THEN pushes ELSE Append(pushes, mainV + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<view, pushCount, req, late>>

mutations.name: no-terminal-stutter
mutations.why: a settled system has no step left: TLC reports the end state as a deadlock
